summary: Granite Construction filed an 8-K to report unwind agreements with capped call counterparties in connection with its redemption of $273.7M 3.75% convertible notes due 2028. The counterparties will pay cash based on five-day VWAP starting August 4, 2026, with settlement expected August 11, 2026. Proceeds will fund note conversions on August 12, 2026. This is a routine debt management action, not a special situation.
